title: lotus creticus var. prostratus
intro: Lotus creticus var. prostratus, commonly known as creeping lotus or creeping sea spurge, is a type of plant in the Euphorbiaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotus creticus var. prostratus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
